title: Redact Image
summary: Helps a redacted screenshot stay redacted: solid boxes only, padded to whole pixels, flattened into a fresh PNG that is re-checked on export.
description: Screenshot redactor with solid boxes only (blur and pixelation can be reversed), padded and snapped to whole pixels, placed by drag or keyboard, with suggestions from a pluggable text detector and a flattened, metadata-free PNG export that is re-read to check every box.
catches: Blur or pixelation used as redaction (only solid fills are offered)
Box edges that leave half-covered pixels, by padding and snapping outward
Sensitive text your detector finds but no box covers
Metadata and trailing data after the image end (aCropalypse-style), by re-encoding to a fresh PNG
Boxes that are not solid in the exported file, by re-reading it
limits: Only as good as the detector you plug in; it does not run OCR by itself
Cannot catch information outside the boxes you or the detector mark (faces, reflections, context)
The original image stays in memory until you discard it; only the export is cleaned
a11y: Boxes can be moved with arrow keys and removed with Delete or Backspace
Each suggestion and remove button has an aria-label; hints wired with aria-describedby
Scan and export progress announced in polite live regions; export failures use role=alert
Undo and Add-box are regular buttons; icons are aria-hidden
server: If the image is uploaded, store only the exported PNG and strip metadata again server-side; never keep the original.
